title: The morbidity iceberg: what the death count leaves out

provenance.definition: PM2.5-attributable adverse birth outcomes in a single year, set against the newborn deaths already counted in the headline toll. Preterm 5.87M (35.7% of all preterm births) and low-birth-weight 2.76M from Ghosh et al. 2021 (PLOS Medicine); stillbirths 0.83M (39.7% of the global total) from Xue et al. 2022 (Nature Communications).
provenance.attribution: Ghosh et al. 2021 (PLOS Medicine); Xue et al. 2022 (Nature Communications)
provenance.primarySource: Both CC BY 4.0 — derived 204-country tables re-hostable with attribution.

recipe.detail: Visible newborn deaths vs the larger, uncounted strata of PM2.5-attributable birth harm.
